summary: Wrote /app/bin/summarize.py (all depot formats, gzip/BOM/UTF-16/charset, mid-file headers and directives, corrections/voids/resends, handovers) and ran it to /app/out/summary.json. check_summary.py reports 10/16 depot and 6/10 month values matching because the reference figures appear to use the true factors lb=0.45359237 and oz=lb/16, whereas summary-format.md specifies 0.45392 and 0.02837; I followed the doc, and changing the KG table at the top of the script to the true factors gives a full match.
